Method of Attack: Supply chain attack injecting malicious JavaScript wallet drainer code
Malicious code used a rogue WalletConnect project to reroute funds to a hacker wallet
Wallet drainer that automatically steals crypto and NFTs from wallets connecting to the app
Attack Vector: Compromised NPM account via phishing attack on a former employee
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious versions 1.1.5 through 1.1.7 of Ledger Connect Kit
Hacker wallet addresses reported by Ledger
